citations.quote: Calamos Advisors LLC 2020 Calamos Court Naperville, Illinois 60563 Ladies and Gentlemen: Re: Management Agreement Pursuant to paragraph 1(b) of the Management Agreement (the 'Agreement') between Calamos Investment Trust and Calamos Advisors LLC dated December 13, 2004, as amended, we hereby notify you that the board of trustees of Calamos Investment Trust have established an additional sub-trust, designated Calamos Emerging Market Equity Fund (the 'New Fund'), and have appointed you as Manager to act as manager and investment adviser to that New Fund on the terms and conditions set forth in the Agreement, except that the advisory fee applicable to the New Fund shall be calculated as follows: The base fee rate shall be at the annual rate of 1.10% of the first $500 million of the average daily net assets; 1.05% of the next $500 million of the average daily net assets; 1.00% of the next $5 billion of the average daily net assets; 0.98% of the next $5 billion of the average daily net assets; 0.96% of the next $5 billion of the average daily net assets; 0.94% of the next $5 billion of the average daily net assets; 0.92% of the next $5 billion of the average daily net assets; and 0.90% in excess of $26 billion. Please sign below to evidence the acceptance of your appointment as Manager for the New Fund designated Calamos Emerging Market Equity Fund, as set forth above and in the Agreement.
